scope: Theorem 10.8 (Uniform unforced-crossing estimate) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 182. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the sufficiently fine rounded Do- brushin interfaces of Lemma 10.5, the conditional probability of crossing an avoidable quadri- lateral tends uniformly to zero as its crossing modulus tends to infinity. Uniformity includes the mesh, every stopping time before completion, every compatible stopped history, and every such quadrilateral in the remaining prime-end domain. For a marked domain approximation of Theorem 1.1, the interfaces, transported to a fixed marked disk, consequently satisfy Condition C2 of [22]. They are jointly subsequentially compact as oriented curves modulo increasing reparametrization and through their half-plane driving functions on compact capacity intervals. Every joint limit is a continuous Loewner-generating curve with the limiting driver, is parametrizable by strictly increasing capacity until the target, and has no additional time-ordered excursions omitted by this description. The target is reached only at completion. Curve compactness also holds in the original physical coordinates.
